contract.task: Predict the arithmetic mean runtime over four runs of a GPU SGEMM kernel multiplying two 2048 x 2048 matrices on the source workstation.
contract.context: MWG/NWG: workgroup tile dimensions; KWG: inner tile dimension; MDIMC/NDIMC: local workgroup sizes; MDIMA/NDIMB: local memory shape; KWI: loop unrolling; VWM/VWN: vector widths; STRM/STRN: memory stride flags; SA/SB: manual-cache flags. Hardware is the fixed NVIDIA GTX 680 setup in the source. Measured runtimes are outcomes and are not inputs.
contract.split: group_by_kernel_configuration; repeated run values remain together

grouping_rule: Known semantic groups unioned with identical prepared inputs; group_id does not prove independence.
missing_policy: No target imputation; invalid/missing targets excluded. Missing features remain null. Explicit invalid-ratio repairs audited.
split_policy: unassigned; use contract split guidance; dataset-family holdouts decided before training

license.name: CC BY 4.0 as recorded on UCI

quality_findings.detail: One mean-runtime target per configuration. Original four times saved in target_observations, never included in prompt. No fabricated variance label.
Actual CSV has 241600 configurations; a paragraph of original Readme incorrectly says 261400.
Different labels for identical prepared inputs are retained, not averaged (except the explicitly defined SGEMM mean target).
Store one identical task/input/label and retain every source occurrence in source_refs/duplicate_count.
Conservative decimal precision cap; original source files unchanged. All changes and old/new IDs retained in numeric_precision_changes.jsonl.gz.

source_values_policy: Original numeric labels except documented arithmetic mean for SGEMM; no learned scaling, clipping or target log transform. Prepared numeric values now follow significant_digits_12_v1; exact originals remain in raw and the versioned history.

numeric_precision.rule: Non-integral finite floats rounded to at most 12 significant decimal digits; integers, null and strings unchanged; no fixed decimal-place rounding or clipping.

prepared_profile_scope: Final normalized, eligible, deduplicated output records. Raw profile retains the original source-table scope.
distribution_format: UTF-8 JSON Lines, gzip compressed, at most 100000 records per shard
